test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'contributes'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context is about how the quality of a Ph.D degree impacts the atmosphere of innovation.
 
• 'Contributes' means to give in order to help achieve or provide something. So, in the context, it is implying that the quality of a Ph.D gives towards creating an ambience of innovation.
 
• 'Contributes' logically fits in the sentence as it suggests that the prestige brought by the high quality of a Ph.D aids in establishing such an innovative environment.
 
• Therefore, the usage of 'contributes' makes the sentence read as "The quality of a Ph.D is of utmost importance as it brings prestige and contributes towards creating an ambience of innovation through research," which makes complete sense in the given context.

**Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Goes': Commonly used to depict movement, not applicable in this context.
 
• 'Efforts': Not apt in this instance as efforts refer to physical or mental activity needed to achieve something.
 
• 'Develops': Typically used to indicate the process of growth or formation, it doesn't fit here.
